title: The loop grows the worker pool only to the 100 profiles master.json holds
description: With a registry worker role allowing 120 workers and master.json holding 11 existing-mode profiles and one launch profile, a loop cycle adds generated worker profiles until master.json holds 100 and no more; configured profiles stay intact, later cycles mint no identity, master status and saveWorkerProfile keep working, and a master.json already grown to 101 loads with its newest generated spare dropped.

steps.name: worker-pool growth stops at the master.json profile limit and the configuration stays readable
